-- Constructs the stylized Cyber Core Chair model (dark metal body, cyan/magenta circuit lines, rotating energy core)
function ChairModelBuilder.buildCyberCoreChair(cfOffset: CFrame?): Model
	local cfBase = cfOffset or CFrame.identity
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "CyberCoreChair"

	local C_METAL = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 32)
	local C_CAP = Color3.fromRGB(35, 40, 60)
	local C_CYAN = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 240)
	local C_MAGENTA = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 200)

	local function make(name: string, size: Vector3, relCF: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material, canCollide: boolean?): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cfBase * relCF
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = if canCollide ~= nil then canCollide else false
		p.CastShadow = true
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	-- 1. Seat
	local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
	seat.Name = "Seat"
	seat.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.7, 4)
	seat.CFrame = cfBase * CFrame.new(0, 2.85, 0)
	seat.Color = C_METAL
	seat.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
	seat.Anchored = true
	seat.CanCollide = true
	seat.CastShadow = true
	seat.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = seat

	-- Neon circuit lines on seat
	make("SeatCircuitX1", Vector3.new(3.8, 0.08, 0.12), CFrame.new(0, 3.22, -1.8), C_CYAN, Enum.Material.Neon)
	make("SeatCircuitX2", Vector3.new(3.8, 0.08, 0.12), CFrame.new(0, 3.22,  1.8), C_CYAN, Enum.Material.Neon)
	make("SeatCircuitZ1", Vector3.new(0.12, 0.08, 3.6), CFrame.new(-1.8, 3.22, 0), C_MAGENTA, Enum.Material.Neon)
	make("SeatCircuitZ2", Vector3.new(0.12, 0.08, 3.6), CFrame.new( 1.8, 3.22, 0), C_MAGENTA, Enum.Material.Neon)
	make("SeatChipCenter", Vector3.new(1.2, 0.06, 1.2), CFrame.new(0, 3.22, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0), C_CYAN, Enum.Material.Neon)

	-- 2. Legs & Caps
	local legOffsets = {
		FL = Vector3.new(-1.6, 1.25, -1.6),
		FR = Vector3.new( 1.6, 1.25, -1.6),
		BL = Vector3.new(-1.6, 1.25,  1.6),
		BR = Vector3.new( 1.6, 1.25,  1.6),
	}
	for tag, offset in legOffsets do
		make("Leg_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.8, 2.5, 0.8), CFrame.new(offset), C_METAL, Enum.Material.Metal, true)
		make("LegTrace_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.12, 2.4, 0.12), CFrame.new(offset.X, 1.25, offset.Z - 0.38), C_CYAN, Enum.Material.Neon)
		local cap = make("LegCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.95, 0.5, 0.95), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.25, offset.Z), C_CAP, Enum.Material.Metal, false)
		
		local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
		pl.Color = C_MAGENTA
		pl.Brightness = 1.5
		pl.Range = 8
		pl.Parent = cap

		make("Gem_LegCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.24, 0.24, 0.08), CFrame.new(offset.X, 0.25, offset.Z - 0.49) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_MAGENTA, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- 3. Posts & Caps
	for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
		local px = if tag == "Left" then -1.6 else 1.6
		make("Post_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.8, 5, 0.8), CFrame.new(px, 5.7, 1.6), C_METAL, Enum.Material.Metal, true)
		make("PostTrace_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.12, 4.8, 0.12), CFrame.new(px, 5.7, 1.18), C_MAGENTA, Enum.Material.Neon)
		local cap = make("PostCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.95, 0.5, 0.95), CFrame.new(px, 8.2, 1.6), C_CAP, Enum.Material.Metal, false)

		local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
		pl.Color = C_CYAN
		pl.Brightness = 1.5
		pl.Range = 8
		pl.Parent = cap

		make("Gem_PostCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.24, 0.24, 0.08), CFrame.new(px, 8.2, 1.11) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_CYAN, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- 4. Backrest panel & Hex Frame
	make("BackrestPanel", Vector3.new(3.2, 4.4, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 5.7, 1.6), C_METAL, Enum.Material.Metal, true)

	local hexR = 0.85
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local rad = math.rad(i * 60)
		local hx = math.cos(rad) * hexR
		local hy = math.sin(rad) * hexR
		make("HexStrut_" .. i, Vector3.new(0.45, 0.10, 0.12), CFrame.new(hx, 5.7 + hy, 1.36) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, rad + math.rad(30)), C_MAGENTA, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- 5. Energy Core (floating rotating gem)
	local core = make("EnergyCore", Vector3.new(0.8, 0.8, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 5.7, 1.35) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), math.rad(45), 0), C_CYAN, Enum.Material.Neon)
	local coreLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	coreLight.Color = C_CYAN
	coreLight.Brightness = 3
	coreLight.Range = 16
	coreLight.Parent = core

	local sparksAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	sparksAtt.Parent = core
	local sparks = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparks.Color = ColorSequence.new(C_CYAN, C_MAGENTA)
	sparks.LightEmission = 1
	sparks.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.6, 0.1)
	sparks.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.6)
	sparks.Rate = 20
	sparks.Speed = NumberRange.new(1.5, 3.5)
	sparks.Parent = sparksAtt

	-- 6. Animation Script
	local scriptObj = Instance.new("Script")
	scriptObj.Name = "CyberEffectController"
	scriptObj.Source = [[
--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local model = script.Parent
local core = model:FindFirstChild("EnergyCore") :: BasePart?
local baseY = if core then core.Position.Y else 5.7
local t = 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	t += dt
	if core and core:IsA("BasePart") then
		core.CFrame = CFrame.new(core.Position.X, baseY + math.sin(t * 3) * 0.18, core.Position.Z)
			* CFrame.Angles(0, t * 1.5, 0)
			* CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), 0, math.rad(45))
	end
end)
]]
	scriptObj.Parent = model

	return model
end

-- Constructs the stylized Frostbite Ice Throne model (carved glowing ice, chevron plates, crown fan of 11 shards)
function ChairModelBuilder.buildFrostbiteThrone(cfOffset: CFrame?): Model
	local cfBase = cfOffset or CFrame.identity
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "FrostbiteIceThrone"

	local C_DEEP = Color3.fromRGB(60, 150, 230)
	local C_MAIN = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255)
	local C_GLOW = Color3.fromRGB(160, 240, 255)
	local C_SNOW = Color3.fromRGB(245, 250, 255)
	local C_GEM = Color3.fromRGB(100, 235, 255)

	local function make(name: string, size: Vector3, relCF: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material, canCollide: boolean?): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cfBase * relCF
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = if canCollide ~= nil then canCollide else false
		p.CastShadow = true
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	-- 1. Seat & Recess
	local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
	seat.Name = "Seat"
	seat.Size = Vector3.new(3.8, 0.7, 3.6)
	seat.CFrame = cfBase * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0)
	seat.Color = C_DEEP
	seat.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
	seat.Anchored = true
	seat.CanCollide = true
	seat.CastShadow = true
	seat.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = seat

	make("SeatCushionRecess", Vector3.new(3.2, 0.25, 3.0), CFrame.new(0, 2.88, 0.1), C_MAIN, Enum.Material.Glass)

	-- 2. Front Chevrons
	for i = 0, 2 do
		local yOff = 2.2 - (i * 0.45)
		make("Chevron_L_" .. i, Vector3.new(1.1, 0.28, 0.2), CFrame.new(-0.55, yOff, -1.85) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-22)), C_GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon)
		make("Chevron_R_" .. i, Vector3.new(1.1, 0.28, 0.2), CFrame.new( 0.55, yOff, -1.85) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad( 22)), C_GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- 3. Legs & Foot Blocks
	local legOffsets = {
		FL = { -1.5, -1.4 },
		FR = {  1.5, -1.4 },
		BL = { -1.5,  1.4 },
		BR = {  1.5,  1.4 },
	}
	for tag, d in legOffsets do
		local lx, lz = d[1], d[2]
		make("Leg_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.8, 2.2, 0.8), CFrame.new(lx, 1.1, lz), C_DEEP, Enum.Material.Glass, true)
		make("FootBlock_" .. tag, Vector3.new(1.15, 0.75, 1.15), CFrame.new(lx, 0.38, lz) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(if tag:find("L") then 15 else -15), 0), C_MAIN, Enum.Material.Glass)
	end

	-- 4. Armrests, Snow Caps & Icicles
	for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
		local ax = if tag == "Left" then -1.9 else 1.9
		make("ArmrestPillar_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.85, 1.8, 0.85), CFrame.new(ax, 1.7, -1.2), C_DEEP, Enum.Material.Glass, true)
		make("Armrest_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.85, 0.85, 3.2), CFrame.new(ax, 3.4, 0), C_DEEP, Enum.Material.Glass, true)
		make("SnowCap_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.95, 0.28, 3.2), CFrame.new(ax, 3.85, 0), C_SNOW, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		for ic = 0, 3 do
			make("Icicle_" .. tag .. "_" .. ic, Vector3.new(0.12, 0.55, 0.12), CFrame.new(ax, 2.75 - ic * 0.05, -1.2 + ic * 0.8), C_GLOW, Enum.Material.Glass)
		end
	end

	-- 5. Backrest Slab & Chevrons
	make("BackrestSlab", Vector3.new(3.4, 5.2, 0.6), CFrame.new(0, 5.1, 1.5), C_DEEP, Enum.Material.Glass, true)
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local yOff = 3.8 + (i * 0.75)
		local w = 1.6 - (i * 0.18)
		make("BackChevron_L_" .. i, Vector3.new(w, 0.32, 0.18), CFrame.new(-w * 0.45, yOff, 1.18) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-26)), C_MAIN, Enum.Material.Glass)
		make("BackChevron_R_" .. i, Vector3.new(w, 0.32, 0.18), CFrame.new( w * 0.45, yOff, 1.18) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad( 26)), C_MAIN, Enum.Material.Glass)
	end

	-- 6. Crown Fan of 11 Shards
	local shardConfigs = {
		{ -2.2, 4.0, -32, 0.48 },
		{ -1.8, 4.8, -26, 0.52 },
		{ -1.4, 5.6, -20, 0.55 },
		{ -1.0, 6.2, -14, 0.58 },
		{ -0.5, 6.8,  -7, 0.60 },
		{  0.0, 7.4,   0, 0.64 },
		{  0.5, 6.8,   7, 0.60 },
		{  1.0, 6.2,  14, 0.58 },
		{  1.4, 5.6,  20, 0.55 },
		{  1.8, 4.8,  26, 0.52 },
		{  2.2, 4.0,  32, 0.48 },
	}
	for idx, cfg in ipairs(shardConfigs) do
		local sx, sh, srot, sw = cfg[1], cfg[2], cfg[3], cfg[4]
		make("CrystalShard_" .. idx, Vector3.new(sw, sh, sw), CFrame.new(sx, 5.2 + sh * 0.45, 1.65) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(srot)), C_GLOW, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	-- 7. Top Diamond Gem & Glow
	local gem = make("TopDiamondGem", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.8, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 8.8, 1.45) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_GEM, Enum.Material.Neon)
	local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 230, 255)
	pl.Brightness = 2.5
	pl.Range = 16
	pl.Parent = gem

	local mistAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	mistAtt.Parent = gem
	local mist = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	mist.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(180, 240, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	mist.LightEmission = 0.8
	mist.Size = NumberSequence.new(1.2, 0.2)
	mist.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.0, 2.5)
	mist.Rate = 12
	mist.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.8, 2.0)
	mist.Parent = mistAtt

	local scriptObj = Instance.new("Script")
	scriptObj.Name = "FrostEffectController"
	scriptObj.Source = [[
--!strict
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local model = script.Parent
local topGem = model:FindFirstChild("TopDiamondGem")
if topGem and topGem:IsA("BasePart") then
	local tw = TweenService:Create(topGem, TweenInfo.new(2.0, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), {
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 250, 255)
	})
	tw:Play()
end
]]
	scriptObj.Parent = model

	return model
end

-- Constructs the stylized Royal Football Throne model (chunky gold throne, red tufted cushion, soccer ball emblem & crown)
function ChairModelBuilder.buildRoyalFootballThrone(cfOffset: CFrame?): Model
	local cfBase = cfOffset or CFrame.identity
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "RoyalFootballThrone"

	local C_GOLD = Color3.fromRGB(255, 195, 30)
	local C_VELVET = Color3.fromRGB(180, 20, 32)
	local C_DARK = Color3.fromRGB(30, 24, 22)
	local C_RUBY = Color3.fromRGB(255, 30, 50)
	local C_WHITE = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	local C_BLACK = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 22)

	local function make(name: string, size: Vector3, relCF: CFrame, color: Color3, mat: Enum.Material, canCollide: boolean?, shape: Enum.PartType?): Part
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cfBase * relCF
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat
		p.Anchored = true
		p.CanCollide = if canCollide ~= nil then canCollide else false
		p.CastShadow = true
		if shape then
			p.Shape = shape
		end
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	-- 1. Base Foot Slabs & Pillars
	for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
		local bx = if tag == "Left" then -1.9 else 1.9
		make("FootSlab_" .. tag, Vector3.new(1.8, 0.6, 3.2), CFrame.new(bx, 0.3, 0), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, true)
		make("Pillar_" .. tag, Vector3.new(1.4, 1.8, 2.4), CFrame.new(bx, 1.5, 0), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, true)
		make("PillarRedPanel_" .. tag, Vector3.new(1.1, 1.4, 0.05), CFrame.new(bx, 1.5, -1.23), C_VELVET, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	end
	make("UndersideHollow", Vector3.new(2.2, 1.6, 2.6), CFrame.new(0, 1.4, 0), C_DARK, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

	-- 2. Seat Frame & Red Quilted Cushion (Seat)
	make("SeatFrame", Vector3.new(3.6, 0.6, 3.2), CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
	seat.Name = "Seat"
	seat.Size = Vector3.new(3.2, 0.8, 2.8)
	seat.CFrame = cfBase * CFrame.new(0, 2.9, 0.1)
	seat.Color = C_VELVET
	seat.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	seat.Anchored = true
	seat.CanCollide = true
	seat.CastShadow = true
	seat.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = seat

	local pl = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pl.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90)
	pl.Brightness = 2.5
	pl.Range = 16
	pl.Parent = seat

	make("FrontDiamondFrame", Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 0.15), CFrame.new(0, 2.5, -1.65) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	make("FrontRubyGem", Vector3.new(0.7, 0.7, 0.22), CFrame.new(0, 2.5, -1.72) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_RUBY, Enum.Material.Neon)

	-- 3. Armrests
	for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
		local ax = if tag == "Left" then -2.2 else 2.2
		make("Armrest_" .. tag, Vector3.new(1.3, 1.4, 3.0), CFrame.new(ax, 3.7, 0), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, true)
		make("ArmrestPanel_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.9, 1.0, 0.05), CFrame.new(ax, 3.7, -1.53), C_VELVET, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		make("ArmrestGem_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.08), CFrame.new(ax, 3.7, -1.58) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	end

	-- 4. Backrest Frame & Wing-Spikes
	make("BackrestFrame", Vector3.new(4.4, 6.2, 0.8), CFrame.new(0, 6.0, 1.4), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, true)
	make("WingSpike_Left", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.8, 0.6), CFrame.new(-2.4, 8.8, 1.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad( 35)), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	make("WingSpike_Right", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.8, 0.6), CFrame.new( 2.4, 8.8, 1.4) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-35)), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

	make("QuiltedPanel", Vector3.new(3.2, 4.8, 0.5), CFrame.new(0, 5.6, 1.1), C_VELVET, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	for row = 0, 2 do
		for col = 0, 2 do
			local bx = (col - 1) * 0.95
			local by = 4.4 + row * 1.15
			make("TuftButton_" .. row .. "_" .. col, Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35), CFrame.new(bx, by, 0.82), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
		end
	end

	make("EmblemRing", Vector3.new(2.8, 2.8, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 7.6, 1.15) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	make("SoccerBall", Vector3.new(2.1, 2.1, 2.1), CFrame.new(0, 7.6, 1.15), C_WHITE, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false, Enum.PartType.Ball)
	make("Pentagon_Center", Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.1), CFrame.new(0, 7.6, 0.08) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(36)), C_BLACK, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)

	local crownPeaks = {
		{ -1.2, 0.8, -18 },
		{ -0.6, 1.2,  -9 },
		{  0.0, 1.7,   0 },
		{  0.6, 1.2,   9 },
		{  1.2, 0.8,  18 },
	}
	for idx, cfg in ipairs(crownPeaks) do
		local px, ph, prot = cfg[1], cfg[2], cfg[3]
		make("CrownPeak_" .. idx, Vector3.new(0.55, ph, 0.45), CFrame.new(px, 9.3 + ph * 0.4, 1.15) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(prot)), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
	end
	make("CrownRubyGem", Vector3.new(0.55, 0.55, 0.25), CFrame.new(0, 9.9, 0.92) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(45)), C_RUBY, Enum.Material.Neon)

	for _, tag in { "Left", "Right" } do
		local bx = if tag == "Left" then -2.6 else 2.6
		make("Banner_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.7, 2.2, 0.08), CFrame.new(bx, 6.2, 1.2), C_VELVET, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic)
		make("BannerCrownEmblem_" .. tag, Vector3.new(0.4, 0.3, 0.04), CFrame.new(bx, 6.6, 1.14), C_GOLD, Enum.Material.Neon)
	end

	local spAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	spAtt.Parent = seat
	local sparkles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	sparkles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 120), Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 20))
	sparkles.LightEmission = 1
	sparkles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.4, 0.08)
	sparkles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1.0, 2.5)
	sparkles.Rate = 10
	sparkles.Speed = NumberRange.new(0.6, 1.8)
	sparkles.Texture = "rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	sparkles.Parent = spAtt

	local scriptObj = Instance.new("Script")
	scriptObj.Name = "RoyalEffectController"
	scriptObj.Source = [[
--!strict
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local model = script.Parent
local ruby = model:FindFirstChild("CrownRubyGem")
local frontRuby = model:FindFirstChild("FrontRubyGem")
local info = TweenInfo.new(1.8, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true)
if ruby and ruby:IsA("BasePart") then
	TweenService:Create(ruby, info, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 100) }):Play()
end
if frontRuby and frontRuby:IsA("BasePart") then
	TweenService:Create(frontRuby, info, { Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 100) }):Play()
end
]]
	scriptObj.Parent = model

	return model
end

-- Generic dispatcher mapping skin id / chair type to builder function
function ChairModelBuilder.buildChair(chairType: string, cfOffset: CFrame?): Model
	local key = string.lower(chairType)
	if key == "crimson" or key == "crimson_chair" or key == "crimsonchair" or key == "crimsonflame" or key == "crimsonflamechair" or key == "emerald" then
		return ChairModelBuilder.buildCrimsonFlameChair(cfOffset)
	elseif key == "cyber_core" or key == "cybercore" or key == "cybercorechair" then
		return ChairModelBuilder.buildCyberCoreChair(cfOffset)
	elseif key == "frostbite" or key == "frost" or key == "frostbitethrone" or key == "frostbitechair" or key == "frostchair" or key == "cyber" then
		return ChairModelBuilder.buildFrostbiteThrone(cfOffset)
	elseif key == "golden" or key == "football_throne" or key == "footballthrone" or key == "royal" or key == "royalthrone" or key == "royalfootballthrone" then
		return ChairModelBuilder.buildRoyalFootballThrone(cfOffset)
	elseif key == "stadium" or key == "stadiumchair" then
		return ChairModelBuilder.buildStadiumChair(cfOffset)
	else
		return ChairModelBuilder.buildStadiumChair(cfOffset)
	end
end

ChairModelBuilder.buildCrimsonChair = ChairModelBuilder.buildCrimsonFlameChair
